terms.gloss: a network of nerves: a neural network
terms.comment: A description of ours: Traupman’s rēte for a network (see network) with nervus, the classical word for a sinew and a nerve (Lewis & Short; Greek νεῦρον). No reference work has a term for it. Where it must be told from the nerves of the body, add artificiāle.

phrases.latin: Rēte nervōrum, ut cerebrum, ex multīs nōdīs cōnstat.
phrases.english: A neural network, like a brain, is made up of many nodes.

sources: Lewis & Short: rete · Lewis & Short: nervus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 261.
